summary: A strong daily either way: eight gimmes, then Soviet Union and Sweden as the fair stretch, with Russia (#14) and Canada (#12) as near misses players learn from. In Blitz every country a casual player names scores.
reasons: Casual run: USA, China, UK, Germany, Australia, France, Japan, Italy, Soviet Union found; lives went on Russia #14, Canada #12, Jamaica, South Korea, Netherlands. Out of lives at 9/10, missing only Sweden.
The Soviet Union vs Russia split is the list's talking point: it costs a life once, but the prompt says 'of all time' and the reveal teaches something. Fan got 10/10 with 2 lives lost.
Blitz is excellent: 26 of 26 casual names scored, including Kenya, Jamaica and India. Values look current (2026 Winter Games included) and US/UK/USSR spellings are well covered.
fixes: Add 'Team GB' as an alias of Great Britain (currently not recognized).
Add 'Aussie' / 'Aussies' as aliases of Australia: 'aussie' currently offers Olympic Athletes from Russia / Russia.

Junk redirect aliases on top-10 entries: Sweden 'Swedish sin', 'Folkland'; Great Britain 'Britain's languages', 'Great Britain's languages'; Soviet Union 'Council Union', 'Soviet order', 'People's republic of russia', 'United states of soviet russia', 'European USSR'; Germany 'De', 'German'; China 'Modern day China'.
